content: शिखरः, -रम् [शिखा अस्त्यस्य-अरच् आलोपः] .²1 The top, summit, or peak of a mountain; जगाम गौरी शिखरं शिखण्डिमत् <ls>Ku. 5. 7</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 5.">4</ls>; <ls>Me. 18</ls>. .²2 The top of a tree. .²3 Crest, tuft. .²4 The point or edge of a sword. .²5 Top, peak, point in general. .²6 The arm-pit. .²7 Bristling of the hair. .²8 The bud of the Arabian jasmine. .²9 A kind of ruby-like gem. .{@-रा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (मूर्वा).
